resources.label: EU VAT scope & Out-of-Scope treatment reference

changes.title: Domestic VAT Out-of-Scope Expansion

updations: Domestic VAT Out-of-Scope provision expanded to include service and digital transaction types (previously limited primarily to product transactions).

changes.summary: The Domestic VAT Out-of-Scope provision in the European Union was expanded effective May 21, 2026.
changes.impact: Out-of-Scope treatment has been expanded to include service and digital transaction types. Prior to this change, treatment was primarily limited to product transactions.
